name: Space Mountain
description: Legendary indoor roller coaster through simulated cosmos inside the iconic white geodesic dome. High-speed turns and drops in complete darkness. A Tokyo Disneyland icon since opening day 1983. Min 102cm.

name: Haunted Mansion
description: Doom buggy journey through 999 happy haunts in a Victorian manor with elaborate animatronics and the beloved ballroom scene. No height requirement.

name: Big Thunder Mountain
description: Wildest ride in the wilderness - runaway mine train with exclusive exploding dynamite effects unique to Tokyo Disneyland. Min 102cm.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
description: Classic 15-minute boat voyage through pirate scenes plundering a Spanish colonial port. No height requirement.

name: Splash Mountain
description: Log flume through Critter Country with five-story final plunge at 45 km/h. Guaranteed soaking. Min 90cm.

name: Star Tours
description: Randomised Star Wars flight simulator with over 100 mission combinations. Exclusive Japanese content. Min 102cm.

name: Buzz Lightyear Astro Blasters
description: Interactive ride shooting laser cannons at Emperor Zurg robots. Competitive scoring. No height requirement.

name: Its a Small World
description: Gentle boat journey past hundreds of singing dolls representing children from every nation. Suitable for all ages.

name: Cinderella Castle
description: Iconic centrepiece of Tokyo Disneyland - 51m tall fairytale castle more ornate than the original Florida version. Spectacular nighttime projection shows nightly.

name: Tomorrowland
description: Futuristic land home to Space Mountain, Buzz Lightyear, Star Tours and Monsters Inc with unique Japanese-exclusive attractions.

name: Monsters Inc Ride and Go Seek
description: Tokyo Disneyland exclusive - hunt for Boo with a torch through Monstropolis. Trackless vehicles take different routes each ride. No height requirement.

name: Jungle Cruise
description: Skipper-guided boat tour through exotic rivers past animatronic elephants, hippos and crocodiles. A Disneyland original since 1955. No height requirement.

name: Mark Twain Riverboat
description: Relaxing cruise on a full-scale steam paddle steamer around Tom Sawyer Island. No height requirement.

name: Western River Railroad
description: Steam-powered narrow gauge locomotive circling the park western frontier through prehistoric canyon scenery. 15-minute journey. No height requirement.

name: Westernland Shooting Gallery
description: Classic Wild West shooting gallery with infrared air-powered rifles targeting animated frontier scenes. Fun for all ages.
